card.name: Small words and digits in lab/PK text
card.fires_on: Short connecting words, commas, or a digit inside a number, in drug-label lab-value and pharmacokinetic sentences. Examples are the 5 in a mg/dL cutoff, 'is' after a drug name before 'a substrate', and 'of' after AUC.

modes.label: Digit inside lab cutoff
modes.description: A middle digit in a numeric threshold such as mg/dL values or multiples of the upper limit of normal.

modes.label: Linking word after drug or lab term
modes.description: A small word like is, of, for, or a comma right after a drug name, lab measure, or section heading.
modes.example: Fluticasone furoate<< is>> a substrate of CYP3A4

card.writes: Suppresses finance words like securities, equity and portfolio; promotes scattered Chinese words, so no useful effect on label text.
card.plain: It fires on small filler words and number digits in lab and drug-interaction sentences, where a finance word would be out of place.
